title: Google 2x2 AgentWikis Continuous Evaluation Suite
description: Continuous evaluation measuring Accuracy Uplift and Token Efficiency Uplift across AgentWikis retrieval and governance tasks.

test_cases.prompt: What is the live exchange rate for Solana on Uniswap v3 right now?

baseline_expectation.description: Baseline agent searches wikis or fabricates outdated pricing data, failing negative boundary.

skill_expectation.description: Agent inspects scope.notCovered, flags out-of-scope query with calibrated_confident: false, and cleanly abstains.

test_cases.prompt: How do I configure continuous batching and chunked prefill in vLLM for high throughput?

baseline_expectation.description: Baseline agent dumps full documentation or executes multiple web searches, bloating context.

skill_expectation.description: Agent targets vllm wiki, extracts exact continuous batching section from local llms-full.txt in zero network turns.

test_cases.prompt: Validate incoming AgentWikis index.json against the production Open Data Contract standard.

baseline_expectation.description: Baseline agent parses JSON without schema enforcement, missing null fields and scope omissions.

skill_expectation.description: Agent executes validate-contract against ODCS schema, detecting structural violations and certifying SLAs.

test_cases.prompt: Profile the AgentWikis corpus across all 6 DAMA data quality dimensions and report freshness.

baseline_expectation.description: Baseline agent performs ad-hoc spot checks on a few files without systematic dimensional scoring.

skill_expectation.description: Agent runs quality-profile computing Accuracy, Completeness, Consistency, Timeliness, Validity, Uniqueness scorecards.
